messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Studies of first trimester use suggest no overall difference in the risk of major birth defects.
Use late in pregnancy has been linked with newborn breathing problems.
Use late in pregnancy has been linked with persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn.
At the same time, stopping an antidepressant during pregnancy raises the risk of depression.
Depression comes back.
The oral solution specifically is not recommended in pregnancy because oral solution contains alcohol.
What are sertraline 150 mg and 200 mg capsules for?
:
Sertraline capsules come in 150 mg and 200 mg only.
Sertraline capsules are not used to start treatment.
Sertraline capsules are for people who need a higher dose.
These people have already been taking 100 mg or 125 mg of another sertraline product.
They have been taking this product for at least a week.
The maximum is 200 mg a day, the same as for tablets.
Capsules should be swallowed whole and not opened, crushed, or chewed.
If you need to come off sertraline, the dose has to be lowered gradually.
This must be done using another sertraline product.
Triples: [["sertraline", "has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning", "no overall difference in risk of major birth defects"], ["sertraline", "has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning", "newborn breathing problems"], ["sertraline", "has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning", "persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn"], ["sertraline", "has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning", "risk of depression"], ["depression", "has outcome", "depression comes back"], ["sertraline oral solution", "contraindicated in", "pregnancy"], ["sertraline oral solution", "contains", "alcohol"], ["sertraline 150 mg capsule", "has dosage form", "capsule"], ["sertraline 200 mg capsule", "has dosage form", "capsule"], ["sertraline capsule", "has strength", "150 mg"], ["sertraline capsule", "has strength", "200 mg"], ["sertraline capsule", "not used for", "starting treatment"], ["sertraline capsule", "used for", "people needing higher dose"], ["sertraline capsule", "used for", "people taking 100 mg or 125 mg of another sertraline product"], ["sertraline capsule", "used for", "people taking another sertraline product for at least a week"], ["sertraline capsule", "has recommended dose", "maximum 200 mg a day"], ["sertraline capsule", "has administration instruction", "swallow whole"], ["sertraline capsule", "has administration instruction", "do not open, crush, or chew"], ["sertraline", "has missed dose instruction", "lower dose gradually"], ["sertraline", "has missed dose instruction", "use another sertraline product to lower dose gradually"]]
Relations: ["contains", "contraindicated in", "has administration instruction", "has dosage form", "has missed dose instruction", "has outcome", "has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning", "has recommended dose", "has strength", "not used for", "used for"]
Answer:

completion:
contains: The subject entity includes or comprises the substance or component specified by the object entity.  
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used in the condition or situation specified by the object entity.  
has administration instruction: The subject drug or dosage form should be administered according to the specific instruction provided by the object entity.  
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.  
has missed dose instruction: The subject drug requires a specific action or precaution when a dose is missed, as specified by the object entity.  
has outcome: The subject condition or event leads to the outcome specified by the object entity.  
has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning: The subject drug has a specific warning or risk associated with its use during pregnancy or breastfeeding, as specified by the object entity.  
has recommended dose: The subject drug has a specific maximum or recommended dose specified by the object entity.  
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.  
not used for: The subject drug or dosage form is not intended for the purpose or patient group specified by the object entity.  
used for: The subject drug or dosage form is intended for the purpose or patient group specified by the object entity.
